model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes for six different multilingual BERT models—mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red)—across nine linguistic categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these linguistic categories in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category contains a group of six colored bars, one for each model, with error bars extending above and below each bar to indicate variability. The bars are sorted within each group by descending height, with the tallest bar (mBERT-B₂ in IE-Indic, for example) typically being dark red, and the shortest bar (often mBERT-L₂ or XLM-L₂ in the “Isolate” group) being light blue or dark blue. The chart visually emphasizes the variation in effect size across both linguistic families and model architectures, with the “IE-Indic” category showing the highest overall effect values and the “Isolate” category showing the lowest.
